peopleAlsoAsk.question: How to make chitosan hydrophobic?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: Chitosan contains an amine group on each of its monomer units and its treatment to render it hydrophobic involves reactions with the amine groups on the chitosan polymer chain. Any optional treatment of chitosan to enhance its bondability to a glass surface would also involve the amine groups.

peopleAlsoAsk.question: Does alginate degrade in water?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: The use of hot water may degrade the alginate viscosity. Under strongly alkaline conditions, viscosity may decrease rapidly. Depending on the type of alkali (e.g., sodium carbonate), dissolving may occur. Under neutral to alkaline conditions, the ester decomposes to form alginate salts.
